Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The bidder must first upload necessary documents on the GeM portal. Necessary document s will be reviewed first. Bidders whose documents are incomplete will be declared ineligible. 2. In order to upload the bidding online on the GEM portal, it is mandatory to attach the follow ing documents :-

01. Copy of the live GST registration form 06/25. 02. Copy of the PAN card and Aadhaar card. 03. Copy of the income tax return for the last year. 04. Copy of the experience certificate/ purchase order for supplying bid required materials to a government institution for 3 years. 05. Turnover proof of the Bidder firm. 06. EMD as Desired. 3. As per regulations, GST and TDS deductions will be made on payments to creditors. 4. The successful bidder must deliver the materials at the jail gate at their own expense. The materials will be tested at the jail gate. If the materials do not meet the specified standards , rejected materials must be immediately taken back. 5. If necessary, the goods may be sent for chemical testing. If the quality of the goods sent for testing is found not to meet the standards, the bidder and their firm will be declared ine ligible for bidding, and their bid and purchase order will be canceled. 6. The Superintendent of Central Jail, Ambikapur, reserves the right to cancel bids on the G eM portal without providing reasons, and no correspondence will be entertained in this reg ard. The decision of the Superintendent will be final and binding for all bidders. 7. No conditions from the bidders will be accepted on the GeM portal. 8. In addition to the above-mentioned conditions, if any rules/conditions are issued at the g overnment level before the bid meeting date, they must be adhered to. 9. The bidding process will be conducted online through the GeM portal. 10. The rates for the materials mentioned in the bid will include all taxes; no additional taxes will be payable separately. 11. The payment for the supply is subject to availablity of funds and clearance of claims of g overment treasuries. 12. Bidder will follow the rules and procedures of GeM. 13. The bill must be placed in the name of the Jail Superintendent, Central Jail Ambikapur. 14. The successful bidder has to submit an agreement for supply of goods with such terms and condition to buyer in notarized non-judicial stamp of Rs.100 as per regulations. The e xpense shall be borne by the supplier firm. 15. The bidder must not have a history of involvement in any criminal activities and no case s shall be registered against him and he should not be held guilty of any offence. He shoul d submit notarized affidavit in non judicial stamp of 100 rupees in this regard. Any submiss ion of false document can lead to cancellation of bidder’s participation and he shall be disq ualified. 16. Successful bidder must submit an additional Ten percent value of total goods quoted as Security Deposit as per Rule 10 of Chhattisgarh Jail Supply Rules 1968. Earnest Money Dep osit in the form of Demand Draft in the name of Jail Superintendent Central jail Ambikapur f rom authorized bank. 17. The quantity and number of goods can be increased or decreased as per requirement of buying authority. Also the goods shall be procured on monthly requirement basis. 18. Earnest money deposit (EMD) is mandatory for all bidders. 19. Earnest Money Deposit will not be accepted in cash. Bidder can submit an Earnest Mon ey Deposit in the form of Demand Draft in the name of Jail Superintendent Central jail Am

bikapur from authorized bank. Also the bid number shall be mandatorily written on the De mand Draft. The copy of the same has to be uploaded on the GEM portal and the original copy must be submitted at the office of Superintendent Central jail Ambikapur before Tw o days of closing of the bid. The earnest money deposit of only successful bidder will be r etained and the deposit of rest of the bidders will be returned after opening/finalization o f the tender. 20. The rates quoted by the successful bidder shall remain valid for a period of one year or until the tender is approved, whichever is earlier. 21. The tender may be cancelled at any time without assigning any condition or reason. 22. The materials supplied must be of high quality. 23. All documents must be accurate, complete and self-attested as applicable Incomplete su bmissions will be rejected. 24.
